verdict.rationale: Autumn is an open-source billing and metering platform with a CLI and SDKs, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never mentions telemetry collection or an opt-out mechanism. Its 'track' and usage-metering features record customers' billable usage, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
